before-song-of-the-elves.npc: I'm afraid not. The city is on lockdown until the rebel elves are dealt with.

before-song-of-the-elves.player: Please, I won't cause any trouble.

before-song-of-the-elves.npc: Rules are rules. No one enters until the criminals are gone.

before-song-of-the-elves.player: Fine, doesn't look very exciting anyway, it's just an empty field.

before-song-of-the-elves.npc: Mind your tongue human. Our great city may be lost to us but that doesn't give you an excuse to talk like that.
